q.en: An ideal step-up (boost) switching regulator has VOUT = VIN/(1 − D). To make 15 V from 5 V the duty cycle D must be

explain.vi: D = 1 − VIN/VOUT = 1 − 5/15 = 0,667 (công thức giảm áp VOUT = D·VIN sẽ cho 0,333 sai).

q.en: A supply has VNL = 5.10 V and an equivalent output resistance of 0.1 Ω delivering a full-load current of 2 A. The load regulation (VNL − VFL)/VFL is
